title: Cavity Barriers – Siderise
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Elevation N, L05 slab edge

questions.q: Is the barrier the specified Siderise product and rating for this location?
Is it positioned per the fire strategy drawing and tight to both faces of the cavity?
Are fixing brackets impaled at the specified centres, with end brackets within 300 mm of each end?
Are joints butted and sealed, with no gaps at junctions or around brackets and services?
Is the barrier labelled and recorded on OneTrace, with photos before it is covered?
